text: There is something invigorating about moving from a closed-off, focused environment—where people are gathered, minds at work, their attention pointed inward—to this open display dedicated to research and discovery. I feel a sense of curiosity and possibility, as if the boundaries between collective learning and individual exploration are blurred and I am free to drift between them. There is intellectual energy in the air, and I am both participant and observer, eager to absorb and contribute.
